tools.name: find_pros
tools.description: The local pros LocalHelpNow lists for one trade in one town, in the order the directory page shows them (Google rating weighted by review count). Each result has the business name, rating, review count, town and the profile page where the homeowner can call or request a quote. Also returns a link to

tools.name: list_service_areas
tools.description: Every trade and town the LocalHelpNow directory has listed pros for, with how many pros each town has and the directory page URL. Optional filters by trade and state.

tools.name: how_pros_are_checked
tools.description: What LocalHelpNow checks before matching a pro (state license, insurance), what it does not do or guarantee, how the directory is ordered, what it costs the homeowner, and what happens if a pro does not work out. Quoted from the site.

tools.name: how_to_get_a_pro
tools.description: What LocalHelpNow does for a homeowner and how the match works, with a link that starts a free match to one pro. Pass trade and area to prefill the request. Does not create a request: the homeowner enters their own details on the page.

tools.name: list_answer_topics
tools.description: Every question the LocalHelpNow Answer Layer covers, by trade: what broke, what a fair price looks like, and whether to repair or replace.

tools.name: get_answer
tools.description: One answer in full: the direct answer first, then price tables with the source and the date they were checked, the repair-or-replace rule and its limits, and the FAQs. Every price range carries where the number came from.

title: Tool description changed since last scan
detail: Tool "how_to_get_a_pro" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "What LocalHelpNow does for a homeowner and how the match works. Pass trade and area to prefill the request. Does not create a request: the homeowner enters their own details on the page."

remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
